Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Mid-Century Rustic Vase, 8.66"H, Neutral
Colors: Green
Materials: stoneware
The reactive glaze used on this 100% stoneware vase is embossed with tonal feather details that make each item unique. Feature this vase alone or with seasonal flowers. 5.59" diameter x 8.66"H 100% stoneware This mid-century vase with a reactive glaze finish has a feather design boasts a gold-finished top. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
